text: Write the race: eight threads incrementing a shared counter. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) ts[i] = new Thread(() -> { for (int k = 0; k < 200_000; k++) ___; });
for (Thread t : ts) ___;            // wait for all of them
explanation: Verified across three runs on the book's machine: 414,984, then 649,224, then 799,209. `plain++` is a read, an add and a write, and threads interleave between them, so most increments are overwritten. Three runs, three answers, none right — which is the property that makes this class of bug so hard: a passing test proves nothing.
